persona: Tele-collections executive at an NBFC moving to a field collections officer role
resumeText:
Ravi Teja Reddy | Hyderabad | raviteja.r@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Tele-Collections Executive, Deccan Finserve Ltd (NBFC), Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Called 120 overdue two-wheeler and personal loan customers a day in the 1-30 DPD bucket.
- Achieved 92% bucket resolution in early delinquency and cut roll forward to 60+ DPD.
- Negotiated repayment plans and tracked promise to pay commitments in the collections dialer.
- Checked CIBIL reports to trace skipped borrowers and their other running loans.
- Explained EMI, foreclosure and late-fee terms of two-wheeler and personal loans to borrowers in Telugu, Hindi and English.
- Followed the RBI fair practices code on calling hours and borrower privacy in every call.
- Maintained daily collection MIS in Excel for the team leader.

EDUCATION
B.Com, Osmania University, 2021

CERTIFICATIONS
IIBF Certificate for Debt Recovery Agents (2022)
